verdict.rationale: Missive's own rules engine now supports multi-step rules that run over time. Each step waits a calendar or business-hours delay, re-checks its conditions, then acts (e.g., escalate at 24/48/72 hrs), so time-based scheduled workflow actions are documented. These are per-conversation delayed sequences triggered by events, though, not recurring or cron-style jobs. Missing for 10: recurring or periodic job scheduling (cron/interval triggers), scheduling of AI assistant or agent runs, API/MCP-driven schedule management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
